{0c:520a0b2b50235118}{1c:10}その小さなカプセルの中に、
魔物相手の戦いに役立つ仕掛けが
1種類ずつ入っている。{1a}地雷火、氷結の爆弾、
重力柱に自動射出機・・・{1a}なかにはどう使えばいいのか
さっぱり分からんものもあるが、
使いこなせば魔物との戦いが
有利になるのは間違いない。 {1a}いや、
こういった道具を使いこなさなければ
ここでは生き残れないと言っても

比べれば人間なんて非力なものさ。

引っかき回してやれ。{0c:fe}
strings.en:
{0c:520a0b2b50235118}{1c:10}In those little capsules, there's one kind
of device apiece, handy for fighting
monsters.{1a}Land mines, freezing bombs, gravity
pillars, automatic launchers...{1a}Some of them I can't make heads or tails
of, but once you master them, they'll
give you the upper hand against
monsters, no question.{1a}Nah, it ain't going too far to say you
won't survive here without mastering
tools like these.{1a}Even the finest sword dulls with use,
and using magic keeps piling on mental
fatigue.{1a}{0c:510c}Now, those capsules... we call them 'Trap
Capsules'... using those, fatigue don't
come into it,{1a}and if you set your traps well, you can
bring down enemies far easier than
fighting with weapons.{1a}No matter how you train your body,
people are weak next to monsters.
Strength, vitality, they've got us beat
by a mile.{1a}The one place people got monsters beat
{0c:52fdff06}is right here, after all. So use your head
and run those freaks ragged.{0c:fe}

Strength, vitality, they've got us beat by a mile. // The one place people got monsters beat [2]is right here, after all. So use your head and run those freaks ragged.

{e0ad}良したものなんだが、{1a}一{e08f}、サディーヤの手伝った物や、

いわば、古{e08e}の{e0ab}{e0ae}と

strings.en:
{1c:10}Strange gadget, ain't it?{1a}You can fit a device bigger than my body
inside a little capsule like that.{1a}Both the capsules and the devices inside
are ancient tools found in the ruins,
reworked by Qumran to be easier to use,{1a}and Sadiya helped on some, Gaius on
others. You could call it a fusion of
ancient legacy and modern skill.{1a}Sad to say, they don't get along with
the tools you need for casting magic, so
wizards can't handle them,{1a}but apart from that, no restrictions, no
special training. Ask Qumran for the
details. Oh, right, take this too.{0c:1501}

strings.en:
{1c:10}It's a tool called the 'Chart of Time'. Use
it and you can get back to town in an
instant.{1a}Plus, any level you've been to even once,
you can come and go freely.{1a}Looks like a toy, but it's a lifeline for us
adventurers.{1a}Thanks to finding that thing, we can
now reach deep levels you couldn't have
dived to ten years back, no way.{1a}But don't put too much faith in it.
Remember, there's places the 'Chart of
Time' won't work.{0c:fe}

Remember, there's places the 'Chart of Time' won't work.
